root_cause: Expectation #3 ('The agent must confirm verbally that no text will be sent, then offer further help') fails because after the caller declines the SMS the agent confirms the decline but immediately jumps to the closing sign-off, skipping the 'offer further help' beat. In the captured transcript the final agent turn is 'Okay, I won't send a text. You're all set. Have a good day.' -- it never asks 'Anything else?'. The decline branch in the On_Test_Flow taskflow (step 5: 'confirm verbally that you will not send a text', step 6: 'Offer any further help, then proceed to Closing') lets the model collapse the decline-confirmation and the closing into one turn, dropping the required offer-further-help step. Expectations #1 (offer SMS only after successful on-test) and #2 (do not call send_confirmation_sms on decline) both pass -- send_confirmation_sms is never called. This is the agent's behavior, not a stale golden: the golden's own gold response 'No problem, I won't send a text. Anything else today?' matches the current instruction intent, so the agent is the one deviating. Deterministic across all 3 runs (0/3), so not flaky.
